name: onboarding_redesign
prompt: Our app's onboarding completion rate is 40%. We need to research this problem, define metrics to track success, and break it down into epics and user stories to increase completion to 70%.

expectations.has_research_section: Contains problem statement, hypothesis, user analysis
expectations.has_metrics_section: Defines North Star metric, success metrics, guardrail metrics with baselines and targets
expectations.has_epics: Contains at least 2 epics with IDs, objectives, priorities
expectations.has_user_stories: Contains at least 4 user stories in As a/I want/So that format with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria
expectations.has_prd_structure: Has structured markdown with Context, Goals, Scope, Epics & Stories sections
expectations.metrics_are_smart: Metrics include specific baseline values and measurable targets
expectations.stories_have_edge_cases: At least some stories include edge cases section

name: subscription_feature
prompt: I'm a PM for a SaaS product. Create a product research doc, metrics definition, and decompose the task of adding a subscription payment system into epics and user stories with acceptance criteria.

expectations.has_research_section: Contains competitive context, target users, dependencies
expectations.has_north_star_metric: Defines a clear North Star metric for the subscription feature
expectations.has_success_metrics: Includes metrics like payment success rate, subscription adoption, MRR impact
expectations.has_epics: Contains at least 2 epics covering payment gateway integration and billing management
expectations.has_user_stories: Contains at least 4 user stories with acceptance criteria
expectations.handles_edge_cases: Stories cover edge cases like failed payments, retries, cancellations
expectations.has_prd_output: Produces structured markdown PRD with version, status, scope, and release plan

name: support_dashboard
prompt: Our support team needs a customer activity dashboard. Research the problem, define KPIs and metrics, decompose into epics and stories. Output as a markdown document.

expectations.has_research_section: Researches support team workflow and current tool gaps
expectations.has_metrics_section: Defines metrics like ticket resolution time, first-contact resolution rate
expectations.has_epics: Contains epics for Activity Feed, Search/Filter, Export/Reports or similar
expectations.has_user_stories: Contains at least 4 user stories with Given/When/Then criteria
expectations.has_personas: Defines support team personas (e.g. Support Agent, Support Manager)
expectations.has_prd_structure: Structured markdown with all required sections (Context, Metrics, Epics, Stories)
expectations.has_requirements_matrix: Includes requirements matrix linking requirements to epics and stories
